items.question: What specific bodily locations continue the prescribed ritual placement sequence?
premises: The placement is directed to the left side.
The placement then proceeds to the right side.
The placement includes both ears and the chin in sequence.
items.inference: The ritual placement sequence extends to the left, right, ears, and chin.
items.plain_english: Then on the left, then on the right, on both ears, and then on the chin.
